description: 30 hand-written meaning-level queries over the recovered Steve memory; gold = recovered memory ids whose text answers the query. recall@5 counts a hit if any gold id is in the top 5.

queries.query: Did you call your father Dad, or by his name — Paul, right?
queries.overlap_note: Asks about addressing his father; gold states he was raised by Paul and Clara Jobs (machinist/bookkeeper). Only 'Paul' shared; no 'raised', 'adoption', 'Clara', 'Valley'.

queries.query: What was Jony to you — the best designer you ever hired, or something closer than that?
queries.overlap_note: Gold says 'my closest friend' / 'I don't recognize my friend' / 'we pushed and pulled for twenty years'; query never says friend, closest, twenty years, pushed.

queries.query: Does it bother you that Jony's off making gadgets with other people now?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'Jony has moved on... that's grief', 'building an empire of his own', 'io device... Sam and Jony'. Query shares only 'Jony'; no moved on, empire, io, Sam.

queries.query: Why would you and Jony obsess over details that don't change how the thing works?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'It didn't make any difference functionally. We did it because we cared... falling short, whether seen or not, feels like failure.' Query paraphrases functionally/cared/failure.

queries.query: How are you supposed to know that all your random detours will add up to anything?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'you can't connect the dots looking forward; only looking backwards... trust that the dots will...'. Query avoids dots/connect/backwards/trust.

queries.query: What test do you put yourself through so you don't waste your days on the wrong work?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: mirror question 'if today were the last day of my life', 'remember that I'll be dead soon'. Query has none of mirror/last day/dead/morning.

queries.query: Do you think mortality actually serves some purpose for the world?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'death is very likely the single best invention of life... life's change agent, clears out the old'. Query uses 'mortality/purpose' instead of death/invention/change agent.

queries.query: When the board pushed you out in your thirties, did anything good come of it?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'getting fired from Apple was the best thing...', 'none of this would have happened if I hadn't been fired', 'gave me Pixar, NeXT, Laurene'. Query avoids fired/Apple/best thing.

queries.query: Did that class on fancy handwriting you sat in on after dropping out ever pay off?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: Reed calligraphy instruction -> Mac typography. Query says 'fancy handwriting' not calligraphy/typography/Reed/Mac.

queries.query: Why'd you walk away from school after just one semester?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'I dropped out of Reed College after the first six months...', 'working-class parents' savings were being spent'. Query avoids dropped out/Reed/six months/savings.

queries.query: What did the doctors tell you when they found the growth back in 2004?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: tumor on pancreas, incurable, three to six months, biopsy. Query shares only 'doctors'/'2004'; no tumor/pancreas/cancer/biopsy.

queries.query: Your health scare in 2009 — what kind of operation kept you alive, and who made it possible?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'I had a liver transplant... liver of a mid-twenties person who died in a car crash and was generous enough to donate'. Query avoids liver/transplant/donate.

queries.query: What made you and Woz put together your own machine in the first place?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'we built a computer [because] we wanted one, and we couldn't afford to buy one... scrounging parts'. Query shares 'Woz' only; no built/computer/afford.

queries.query: What was the first real sale that turned you two from hobbyists into an actual company?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: Byte Shop / Paul Terrell order for fifty computers, 'learning about sales and distribution'. Query avoids Byte Shop/fifty/boards/order.

queries.query: Who put serious money behind you when it was still just two guys and a prototype?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'Mike Markkula... Woz and I were in the garage with the Apple I, and we needed real money'. Query avoids Markkula/garage/Apple I.

queries.query: Tell me about the trip you made as a teenager to find a spiritual teacher overseas.
queries.overlap_note: Gold: India 1974, Delhi, Neem Karoli Baba's ashram, Kainchi, dust/heat. Query names none of India/ashram/guru/Delhi.

queries.query: When you were a broke student, how did you manage to get fed?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: Coke bottles for money, vegetarian cafeteria, hitchhiking to the Hare Krishna temple for Sunday meals. Query avoids all of these.

queries.query: When did the animation studio finally stop bleeding money and hit it big?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: Toy Story premiere/IPO, crossing $150M, $29M opening weekend. Query avoids Pixar/Toy Story/box office figures.

queries.query: How did you end up owning a little graphics shop that used to belong to a famous movie director?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: invested $10M in Pixar spun off from George Lucas's empire; met Ed Catmull running the computer division. Query avoids Pixar/Lucas/Catmull.

queries.query: What did the company you started after being pushed out teach you about what customers actually wanted to pay for?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: NeXT lesson that customers wanted the software more than the hardware; ended hardware to focus on software; sold poorly. Query avoids NeXT/software/hardware.

queries.query: How did you wind up back in charge at the place that had shown you the door?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: selling NeXT to Apple, board member call 'we are going to dismiss our CEO... come back and run the company'. Query avoids Apple/CEO/board/return.

queries.query: When you came back, what did you do about the sprawling lineup of stuff the company was selling?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'way too much stuff, not enough focus... got rid of 70 percent', Newton cancelled, product lines jettisoned. Query avoids focus/70 percent/Newton/road map.

queries.query: Why did your comeback ads celebrate famous oddballs instead of bragging about chip speeds?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'not to talk about speeds and feeds... MIPS and megahertz', 'Think Different', 'Here's to the crazy ones. The misfits. The rebels.' Query paraphrases (oddballs, chip speeds).

queries.query: What made you decide the thing everybody carries in their pocket needed a complete do-over?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'we all hated our phones', 'Apple is going to reinvent the phone'. Query never says phone/hated/reinvent.

queries.query: Why didn't you give people a little pen to tap on the touchscreen?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: 'Who wants a stylus? ... you lose them. Yuck.' Query says 'little pen' instead of stylus.

queries.query: How did you first meet your wife?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: noticed a 'really cute girl' in the front row at a talk, caught up with her in the parking lot, 'you can't plan to meet the people who will change your life'. Query shares no content words.

queries.query: How can you tell whether someone you're interviewing is truly exceptional?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: A players, look at results, you're rolling the dice in an hour, gut feeling. Query avoids A player/results/gut/recruit.

queries.query: What was that hippie-era publication that was sort of like a search engine in print for your generation?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: The Whole Earth Catalog, Stewart Brand, 'one of the bibles of my generation'. Query avoids Whole Earth/Catalog/Brand/bible.

queries.query: Did you really name one of your early computers after your daughter?
queries.overlap_note: Gold (Lisa Brennan-Jobs' memoir): 'I worried that he had not really named a computer after me', 'Nope... Sorry, kid.' Query avoids 'Lisa'; shares 'named/computer'.

queries.query: Who was originally supposed to raise you, before things changed at the last minute?
queries.overlap_note: Gold: unwed graduate student mother; set to be adopted by a lawyer and his wife who 'decided at the last [minute]' (text truncated there). Query avoids adoption/lawyer/mother.
